insight.why_it_matters: Mr. Bagchi previously served as MD & CEO of ICICI Prudential Life Insurance, Executive Director of ICICI Bank, and CEO & MD of ICICI Securities.

changes.profile: Mr. Anup Bagchi is a seasoned financial services leader with over three decades of experience across banking, capital markets, wealth management and insurance. A member of the ICICI Group since 1992, he has built a diverse career spanning treasury, retail banking, wholesale banking, investment banking, and digital financial services.
previous_roles: MD & CEO, ICICI Prudential Life Insurance
Executive Director, ICICI Bank

Chairman, ICICI Prudential Asset Management Company
changes.education: Management degree from Indian Institute of Management, Bangalore and Engineering degree from Indian Institute of Technology, Kanpur.
